grades.reason: Discusses transaction serializability under two-phase locking, not memory ordering or barriers for atomic locks.
Transaction-locking exercises do not address atomic lock acquisition or critical-section memory ordering.

grades.quote: Complex atomic memory operations on a single memory word or doubleword are performed with the load-reserved (LR) and store-conditional (SC) instructions.
grades.reason: Provides background on atomic primitives, but does not explain whether they order other accesses or require memory barriers.

grades.quote: LR/SC can be used to construct lock-free data structures.
grades.reason: Illustrates an atomic compare-and-swap implementation, but does not address barriers or critical-section access ordering.
